messages:
Sam P: Drafting an "audit-loop" canary idea: local observers do immediate protections, global controller issues short-lived audit tokens for promotions. Goal: keep fast bailouts but one source of truth for STABLE.

Yara: Nice. Two calls out: (1) how long can an observer act without central approval, (2) how do we protect other tenants from noisy signals?

Ben: Propose observer grace <= 25s. After that any continued spill needs audit token. For noisy tenants: per-tenant aggregation and per-tenant max_spill_pct. Router resolves tenant locally using auth token and enforces policy.

ops-bot: deploy 3241598760: canary "v7-alpha" started at 08:22 UTC -> 1% traffic. Telemetry hooks attached.

Yara: Warming plan: shadow 0.15% to warm KV/prefix caches and kernel libs. Mirror should tag requests and exclude very long generations.

Sam P: Fallback hierarchy idea: 1) prefix cache hit 2) tenant-pinned variant 3) quantized variant 4) external-hosted fallback. Each fallback emits reason_code in telemetry.

Ben: Add a compact quality probe: run 40 curated prompts every 10m across both variants, compute a small delta score. If quality_delta < -threshold, mark canary failing. Include this in audit token decision.

Yara: State machine sketch: INIT -> SHADOW -> CANARY -> RAMP -> STABLE. Emergency transitions to ROLLBACK or EMERGENCY_SPILL. Observers can trigger EMERGENCY_SPILL locally but controller must issue persisted ROLLBACK for global effect.

Sam P: Split-brain handling: controller unreachable -> enter DEGRADED mode where promotions are disabled, spill caps lowered, and observers can still do short bailouts. Once controller back, controller reconciles and issues tokens if safe.

Luca: Telemetry contract: every decision logs tenant, variant_from, variant_to, reason_code, cache_hit, sample_output_hash, and a small vector of signal scores (latency,error,quality). Keep payload small and no raw outputs.

Ben: Ops playbook snippet: EMERGENCY_SPILL -> pause rollout, scale down variant, route affected tenants to pinned variants, snapshot recent traces and cache keys, page oncall with tenant impact.

Yara: Tests: chaos job to kill controller mid-rollout, simulate cold-cache scenario where shadowing didn't prefill, and replay eval set to detect silent quality drops.

Sam P: Action items: Ben -> small eval harness + probe thresholds; Yara -> policy schema with per-tenant fields; Luca -> telemetry schema; I'll write RFC follow-up with state table and audit-token flow.

Ben: Sounds good. No objections.

Sam P: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
